test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

The manager asked / the cooking team, “Who / among you is to baked the / Christmas cake this year?”

options.text: among you is to baked the

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form** "baked" after "is to."**
 
• The correct verb form should be** "bake" **to match the infinitive structure **"is to."**
 
• The correct phrase should be **"among you is to bake the,**" ensuring grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **Option 4** of the sentence.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The manager asked the cooking team, “Who among you **is to bake the Christmas cake** this year?”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "the cooking team, “Who"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 2: "Christmas cake this year?”"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 3: "The manager asked"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Option 5: "among you is to baked the"** – This part contains the error as it should be "among you is to bake the."
